newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia '96 property deals up 22.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia '96 property deals up 22.9 pct.

text.p: Malaysian property deals rose by an annual 22.9 percent in 1996 to 49 billion ringgit, an official report said on Tuesday.
The government's Valuation and Property Services Department said in its annual report that the figure compared with 39.86 billion ringgit in 1995.

The residential and agricultural sectors showed smaller percentage increases in the total number of transactions while the commercial and industrial sectors showed an overall drop in the total number of transactions, said the Property Market Report 1996.
It added: "On the whole the property market in 1996 consolidated from the robust performance of last year".
The department is a part of the Ministry of Finance.
